title: Declare it, then build it
sub: In the weeds of data crafting, a technical series for analytics engineers: declare the data model beside the code, then build it with dbt, in ten steps. A dbt model is how you make it, not the model.
howto: White lines on blue are the model, the blueprint. Code on dark glass is the building work. Teal is an AI agent's work; gold is a person's approval.
